load_policy_from_path: load a TF SavedModel policy from a given file path and return an unbatched policy object
create_stateful_policy: create a stateful policy callable that manages internal state for dm_control viewer integration
define_policy_protocol: define a Policy protocol with step and initial_state methods for type-checking policy implementations
build_mpo_state: build an _MPOState NamedTuple holding counter, actor, and critic tensors for policy state management
test_policy_step: test the policy step function with a dm_env TimeStep and _MPOState to produce an action output
